notes.title: Keyboard Support
notes.notes:
Now the game support keyboard input! 
ABXYLR button = key...

Keys function description exist at in-game menu's Info section.

notes.title: Officially released!
notes.notes:
It is long time.
Finally this game released now!

You will need Xbox Controller or Nintendo Switch Pro Controller for easily control game. 

Thank you.

notes.title: Start working on this again!
notes.notes:
Hi.
Long time no update. Sorry. Various things existed. 
Anyway, currently start to hardly working again. 

Now updating game design for new card mechanics like Equipment, Devices, and Monster Allies. Yes monster card will be added and they will be party member and helps battle, adventure. And shop, inventory, equipment functions too will be adopted.

And scenarios too. I will added more various scenarios from short game (3~5 minutes play time) to medium, long time game(20~30 minutes). 

Please wait more and I will finish this game. 
Let me know your opinions too.
Thanks.

notes.title: 1.01 Patch!
notes.notes:
2017-08-06
New version updated. 

1. Save & Load function 
Originally, only card and gold, coin purchase, uses are saved automatically.

Now, in-game progress (Character level, skills, cards, position) can be saved manually. Save menu is located at system menu. 

And in main-lobby screen, you can choose between (new game start) or (load game)


2. After the final battle of main quest at portal, bug revised.
